mapper.sql: assignment.id AS assignment_id, task.id AS task_id, task.title, student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, assignment.source_type, assignment.source_organization_id, source_organization.organization_name AS source_organization_name, assignment.current_status, assignment.current_reviewer_id, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_display_name, checkin.id AS checkin_id, checkin.submission_no, checkin.content AS checkin_content, checkin.status AS checkin_status, checkin.submitted_at, checkin.review_comment
